=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py
  Line or code reference: lines 1513-1517 (the `if _unquoted_gh_api_expansion(stripped_command):` block returns `DECISION_ASK`); literal-ID read-loop approval sits at lines 1528-1530 and is unreachable for any `gh api` command
  Problem: The unquoted-expansion check fires `DECISION_ASK` before the literal-ID read-loop approval (`_is_approvable_read_loop`) at line 1528 ever runs, so every vetted literal-ID loop containing `gh api` is ASK'd instead of ALLOW'd, every unvetted loop pattern returns ASK instead of the contract-mandated `None`, and the DELETE-in-loop case never picks up `_ECHO_READ_HINT` that `test_hidden_read_and_loop_write_asks_name_a_safe_rewrite` requires.
  Why it fails at runtime: For `for r in 1 2; do gh api repos/o/r/actions/runs/$r/jobs; done`, `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` returns True because `$r` is an unquoted expansion inside a `gh api` argument, so the guard returns `DECISION_ASK` and the literal-ID read-loop approval at line 1528 (which is the documented §23.H path that should allow this exact pattern — see lines 1439-1440 which already short-circuit the no-`gh-api` case) is bypassed. Same root cause drives all 11 test failures in the CI log: 4 `test_upstream_literal_id_loop_frame_is_preserved`/`test_literal_id_read_loop_is_allowed` cases that should return `DECISION_ALLOW`, 5 `test_unvetted_loop_keeps_no_decision` cases that should return `None` (because `_is_approvable_read_loop` would have refused and the guard then falls through), and 1 `test_hidden_read_and_loop_write_asks_name_a_safe_rewrite` case where the ASK reason is missing the safe-rewrite hint the test expects.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
- Requirement: "Three CI jobs fail on main (`49c2f38`) and therefore on every open PR... `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `tests-promote-stall-and-review`, `tests-release-and-log-analysis`, plus `lint`, which aggregates them. Each failure reproduces on a clean `main` worktree. All three are stale tests or docs, not product bugs" (PR description intro).
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` `evaluate()` ordering: move the literal-ID read-loop approval (currently at lines 1528-1530) before the `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` check (currently at lines 1513-1517), and add `_ECHO_READ_HINT` to the unquoted-expansion ASK reason so the DELETE-in-loop case still receives the safe-rewrite hint the test contract demands.
  Evidence of absence: The CI log shows `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failing with 11 distinct test failures in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` (lines 630, 657, 686, 805 — `test_upstream_literal_id_loop_frame_is_preserved`, `test_literal_id_read_loop_is_allowed`, `test_unvetted_loop_keeps_no_decision`, `test_hidden_read_and_loop_write_asks_name_a_safe_rewrite`). The PR diff contains zero changes to `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` or `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`, even though the PR description's own intro paragraph lists `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` as one of the failing CI jobs this PR is supposed to fix. The "all three are stale tests or docs" claim is incorrect for the third job: `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails because of a real product bug (the `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` check fires before the literal-ID read-loop approval), not a stale test. Without fixing this bug, the PR's own `lint` aggregate will continue to fail on this branch and the PR cannot merge.
